rows.grounds: object whose measure is being fixed

items.question: What alternative measurement fixes the pedestal height when the image is not arranged in the ninefold square?
items.inference: Thus the pedestal height may be set from the root of the brahma-staff instead of the ninefold arrangement.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of brahma-staff remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Or, [set] the height of the pedestal from the root of the brahma-staff.
